name: 84044 · Magna, UT
findings: ZIP 84044 (Magna) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84044 (Magna) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84044 (Magna) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 34% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.
